images.label: 1 — Sofa listening
images.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset: one standalone 16:9 landscape landing-page hero photograph for Hey Kahani.
Reference image: ONLY the product design is referenced. Preserve the Kahani Player silhouette: rounded cream cylinder, high arch carry handle, five cream embossed controls in a cross arrangement, lower Gulab red #D3000A woven speaker band, thin light wood base. Preserve its length-to-width proportions while making the entire physical object MUCH SMALLER.
CRITICAL SCALE: this is a compact portable children's audio player, not a big speaker or appliance. As a visual scale target for this concept, use approximately 8 cm body diameter and 16 cm total height including the handle. Body width must be about HALF the width of the child's face, comfortably small enough to cradle in one child's hand. Full player height including handle is shorter than the child's head. A Koel is a SMALL thin circular illustrated story token, approximately 4 cm across, about the width of three child fingertips, distinctly smaller than a child's palm and roughly half the player's body diameter. It is NOT a coaster, saucer, plate, or oversized disc. Exactly three small Koels in the scene, one seated on the recessed top and two nearby or one held as specified. These measurements are concept scale targets, not product claims. Keep child and product at the SAME camera distance so perspective cannot enlarge the product.
Photographic realism: documentary family lifestyle photograph, natural child skin with fine hairs, uneven hair strands, everyday cotton fabric wrinkles, believable soft daylight, understated real expression. Avoid polished catalog posing, beauty retouching, glossy render look, artificial background gradients or digital beige haze. Warm cream, Kesar sand, natural oak, muted peach/coral/mango accents. The left 30-35% is naturally quiet usable space from the real home scene for page copy; no text generated.
Create an entirely new child with the specific distinct facial features described in this shot. Do not use a curly-haired floral-dress girl. Exactly ONE child, ONE small Player, three SMALL round Koels. No other people. No phones/tablets, headphones, logos, interface elements, typography, watermarks, excessive toys or decorative props. No overhead rug shot, no child lying on floor or bed, no hands-under-chin pose. Product must have believable contact shadow and match scene light.

SHOT 1: a candid medium-wide photograph at the seated child's eye height, straight-on but with the child looking naturally toward an off-camera window. A DIFFERENT South Asian girl aged 6: straight jet-black CHIN-LENGTH BOB, warm brown skin, oval face, small wide-set dark eyes, a quiet imperfect smile. She wears a pale peach cotton T-shirt and simple cream shorts. She sits sideways comfortably at the far-right end of a pale cream linen sofa, legs tucked loosely to one side. The very small Player is supported on the sofa cushion beside her hip at the SAME depth as her body; its full height is clearly shorter than her head. One tiny Koel is on top of the Player, two tiny Koels sit beside it on the cushion. Her relaxed hand next to the product makes its compact scale unmistakable. This is a quiet absorbed listening moment, not showing the product to camera. Wide view includes the sofa and a little uncluttered real room; left sofa cushions provide the copy area. Soft diffused morning light, editorial and lived-in.
